links.outcome: Medication-safety risk flags in LLM responses to COPD management cases
links.effect: Medication-safety risk occurred in 26.93% and serious medical risk in 1.44% of AECOPD-PIM responses.
links.quote: medication-safety risk and serious medical risk occurred in 26.93% and 1.44% of AECOPD-PIM responses.

links.outcome: Output accuracy and safety of LLMs against physician-adjudicated reference answers and rubrics
links.effect: Mean final score across 623 cases was 68.58; imaging hallucination in 31.85% and serious medical risk in 8.16% of PNBIM responses.
links.quote: Imaging hallucination and serious medical risk occurred in 31.85% and 8.16% of PNBIM responses;

unlisted_practices: Clinical-action-point (atomic action recall) benchmark combined with LLM-as-a-Judge and independent safety flags for model selection

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a benchmark (RESPClinBench) evaluating multimodal LLMs on respiratory decision-making and safety risks, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
